plan.title: AD lesional vs control skin DE + hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 skin samples (6 AD lesional, 6 control), raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples), single batch, unpaired. sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median, which the design knowledge base says to keep, inspect, and report rather than drop by default. The plan: (1) sample-structure QC with a blind VST, PCA, and sample-distance heatmap to see where sample_01 falls and whether it clusters with its labeled group before any test runs, with an explicit go/no-go decision on inclusion; (2) DESeq2 differential expression (~condition, reference level = control) with a minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples), median-of-ratios normalization, Wald test, apeglm shrinkage, and BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha=0.05 to answer 'which genes change'; (3) fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (primary, per the research question) with Reactome as a secondary confirmatory collection, to answer 'which hallmark pathways change'; (4) an edgeR quasi-likelihood run on the same design as a robustness cross-check, since replicate number (n=6/group) sits in the range where DESeq2 and edgeR can disagree; (5) an integrated report consolidating DE tables, the two-method overlap, GSEA results with leading-edge genes, QC diagnostics, and a full reproducibility record (session info, seed, package/collection versions).
